info.title: reverb
info.description: Reactive C# notebooks that are plain .cs files.

commands.name: check
commands.description:
Report compiler and notebook diagnostics.
Exits non-zero if there are errors.

commands.name: convert
commands.description:
Convert a Jupyter or Polyglot notebook to a Reverb
notebook (-o out.cs, --force to overwrite).

commands.name: edit
commands.description:
Open a notebook in the editor (a local web page).
--port <n>                     Port to listen on (default: any free port).
--no-browser                   Print the address instead of opening a browser.

commands.name: exec
commands.description:
Run a notebook headlessly and print its outputs.
Exits non-zero if any cell fails.

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Run a notebook and write a self-contained HTML page
of its outputs (-o out.html, --no-code).

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a notebook and open it in the editor.

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Serve a notebook as a read-only app: outputs and
widgets only, code hidden.
--port <n>, --no-browser       As for edit.
--host <address>               Listen on this address (default 127.0.0.1).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help.
A notebook also runs without Reverb: dotnet run file.cs

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on (default: any free port).

options.name: --no-browser
options.description:
Print the address instead of opening a browser.
run <file.cs>                      Serve a notebook as a read-only app: outputs and
widgets only, code hidden.

options.name: --host
options.description:
Listen on this address (default 127.0.0.1).
export <file.cs> --html            Run a notebook and write a self-contained HTML page
of its outputs (-o out.html, --no-code).
convert <file.ipynb | file.dib>    Convert a Jupyter or Polyglot notebook to a Reverb
notebook (-o out.cs, --force to overwrite).
